title: Give OLY-3-06 a mechanism: count items per feedback dimension
summary: Add a function in crates/athena-core/src/introspect.rs, beside filled_feedback_dimensions, that reports how many hypotheses or work items an IntrospectionRecord holds for each of the ten FEEDBACK_DIMENSIONS. It counts several where a field is a list. Then record it as OLY-3-06's mechanism and measure in docs/spec.toml, with a test. The audience is the Athena maintainers and the verifier.

defaults_applied.how: New unit test, with fmt, clippy and test passing.
The criterion checks counts above 1 from a real record, not just that the function exists.
One function and one spec entry.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Code survey: read crates/athena-core/src/introspect.rs (FEEDBACK_DIMENSIONS, filled_feedback_dimensions and its test around line 1943); the record type is IntrospectionRecord. Calls to the new function come from tests only. No record or data file is added under crates/, so check_record_file and AnyRecord are untouched. The property is measured directly by calling the new function on records.
Assumption: 'several' is shown by per-dimension counts that can exceed 1, taken from list fields such as decisions_matched and earlier_cases (one count per entry); single-valued fields count 0 or 1.
The measure ends with 'status: not shown' and names the test, as for OLY-3-05, because no athena status line prints this.
Governance: docs/spec.toml is the only config-like deliverable. athena.toml and defaults.toml do not change.
Existing code: extends crates/athena-core/src/introspect.rs (filled_feedback_dimensions and FEEDBACK_DIMENSIONS) and docs/spec.toml; creates nothing new.

acceptance_criteria.text: docs/spec.toml requirement OLY-3-06 has a mechanism naming crates/athena-core/src/introspect.rs and the new function (not 'none'), owner 'Athena', and a measure naming the test and ending with 'status: not shown'. Check with Grep on docs/spec.toml.

Run cargo test -p athena-core on the new test. It builds a record with several decisions_matched and earlier_cases entries and asserts the per-dimension counts exceed 1 for those dimensions and are 0 for blank ones. The test fails if the function is stubbed to return one per filled dimension.
cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy and cargo test all pass from the repository root.
The new function exists in introspect.rs, is named in the spec mechanism text, and is reached by a test in the same file.

out_of_scope: Printing a per-dimension line in athena status
